row.title: OpenAlex refuses Cloudflare Workers without a key; give the ledger keyless routes and a second egress
row.body: LEDGER-KEYLESS-1: OpenAlex answers 429 'Insufficient budget. This request has no API key' to the Replication Ledger Worker, and Europe PMC covers only biomedicine. The beat now tries, after OpenAlex refuses: the OpenAlex mirror a GitHub runner lands daily (data/openalex.json via ledger-openalex.yml, same openalexCandidates and discoverFindings code, zero subrequests), Europe PMC, then Crossref works search and Semantic Scholar paper search (keyless.js, one shared BEAT.KEYLESS call budget per beat, a record kept only when it names the finding). Every record goes through the same reader and verbatim-quote guard. /api/citations now reports total, checked and unchecked against the seed DOIs and answers 503 after 24 beats when any is unchecked or failed (detector replication-ledger-citations, fm-unverified-citations), so never-verified no longer reads as verified.
